svg.title: STSF-TPLS (arXiv 2026, PyTorch): Image-free sensing can be more robust to measurement noise than reconstructing an image first.
svg.desc: Portrait-derived decorative motif: computed Walsh-Hadamard samples 1 through 24 of the author's public portrait. Each interval is independently linearly scaled; these are not project measurements or performance. Research context: Single-pixel segmentation · clean training, noisy testing.
